subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform user tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or a narrower extension of plugin scheduled-turn tags?
rationale: This choice becomes a persisted cron state and Gateway protocol contract shared by CLI, API clients, Control UI, reminders, and plugin scheduling, so automation should not choose the durable shape alone.

options.title: Typed classification/display metadata
options.body: Create a small first-party cron purpose/display contract that can support reminders and UI filtering without overloading freeform tags.

options.title: Freeform tags array
options.body: Accept the reporter's tags model directly and make tags the primary user-facing grouping/filtering API.

options.title: Plugin-tag extension only
options.body: Extend the existing plugin scheduled-turn tag mechanism narrowly and defer broader user-visible categories.

recommendation.title: Typed classification/display metadata
recommendation.body: Create a small first-party cron purpose/display contract that can support reminders and UI filtering without overloading freeform tags.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest prior maintainer signal that cron metadata is an API/protocol design decision requiring owner review.
